archetypes.assignment: DEV/HOLDOUT use frozen TRAIN medians/scaler/PCA/centroids; never refit
archetypes.same_second_rule: no tx/log ordering inside a one-second block-time timestamp; batch aggregation is frozen before outcomes.
archetypes.selection: cluster count fixed ex ante at 6; not selected by predictive performance
archetypes.stability: 5 deterministic bootstrap fits; report adjusted Rand index
archetypes.training: TRAIN-only latest participant timestamp states with >=20 prior fills and >=2 prior active days; if multiple rows share that latest second, fingerprint features are averaged across the whole timestamp batch before fitting.
archetypes.transform: TRAIN-only StandardScaler -> PCA up to 6 components -> MiniBatchKMeans k=6

compute.ec2: Git/hashes/packaging/synthetic tests only; no empirical participant analysis
compute.operational_amendment: User clarified shared Kaggle concurrency is 5 sessions, not 3; amended before any 005E empirical outcome inspection.

data.economic_trade_grain: validated passive OrderFilled rows from transaction-condition groups with exactly one active row, >=1 passive row, binary YES/NO semantics, size conservation and YES-notional conservation
data.manifest_transport_note: Kaggle mount differs from canonical repo manifest only by CRLF line endings; parsed JSON equality remains mandatory.
data.participant_grain: one participant-side OrderFilled row after canonical infrastructure exclusion
data.sample_policy: deterministic hash sample capped at 750000 participant rows per family; US_2024 must contribute at least 600000 sampled rows or fail closed

dev_screening.participant_family_gate: positive weighted MSE gain versus generic baseline on primary target AND positive family-specific gain in >=3 of 5 families
dev_screening.pre_holdout_freeze: write immutable JSON binding cuts, archetype transform, selected families/features, frozen model specs and omissions before HOLDOUT
dev_screening.variant_selection: hyperparameters and feature-family shortlist selected on DEV only; raw p-value never selects

falsification: participant-state permutation preserving family/market/time-activity strata where support permits

holdout_inference.bootstrap: 500 deterministic hierarchical family -> calendar-day block resamples after first collapsing row loss gain to market-timestamp batches.

disposition_gates.CROSS_FAMILY_CANDIDATE: full-behaviour primary target has positive HOLDOUT gain, BH q<=0.05, positive family gain in >=3/5 families, top-participant absolute effect share <0.50, effective contributing participants >=10, and neither preregistered participant-state permutation matches/exceeds observed gain
disposition_gates.INCONCLUSIVE: required coverage/provenance/falsification evidence is unavailable or internally contradictory
disposition_gates.NO_INCREMENTAL_EVIDENCE: full-behaviour primary HOLDOUT gain <=0 or BH q>0.05
disposition_gates.REGIME_SPECIFIC_CANDIDATE: full-behaviour primary target has positive HOLDOUT gain, BH q<=0.05 and positive family gain in at least one but fewer than three families, or broad-concentration/transfer gates fail without a stronger falsification contradiction

holdout_inference.final_refit: after DEV freeze, refit each frozen model on the union of TRAIN+DEV with unchanged features/hyperparameters; HOLDOUT is never used in fitting or tuning
holdout_inference.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg at alpha=0.05 across all frozen primary participant variants; unavailable/negative variants remain in the family
holdout_inference.primary_statistic: baseline squared-error loss minus challenger squared-error loss
transfer: leave-family-out retraining diagnostic where support permits
holdout_inference.weighting: equal family -> market -> observable timestamp batch -> participant-row weight; prevents same-second multi-fill batches from dominating fit/evaluation.

infrastructure.policy: exclude all canonical infrastructure addresses from participant ecology/skill claims; unknown does not imply human; no deanonymisation

past_only_rules.direction_semantics: owner YES pressure only; never called aggressor/taker direction
past_only_rules.historical_markout: 300s directional markout becomes available only at trade timestamp + 300s and enters later rows strictly after availability; shrinkage lambda=20 toward zero
past_only_rules.simultaneous_rows: same-second rows are treated as one observable batch for evidence weighting; they may retain row-specific current size/side but cannot become each other historical state.
past_only_rules.sparse_participant: strong shrinkage; archetype assignment forced to sparse class when prior fills <20 or prior active days <2
past_only_rules.timestamp_batch: DATA-002 block-time is one-second resolution. Participant history uses only rows with timestamp strictly less than the current row timestamp; tx_hash/log_index never create pseudo-order inside a second.

pre_outcome_amendment_same_second: Strict timestamp-batch semantics replaced lexical same-second row ordering before any successful 005E empirical processing.

primary_target.definition: 60-second future own-market canonical YES logit change
primary_target.name: y_60

question: Does observable participant behaviour contain repeatable predictive information about subsequent market state?

secondary_targets.definition: future logit change after next 2 economic trades
secondary_targets.name: event_2

secondary_targets.definition: future logit change after next 10 economic trades
secondary_targets.name: event_10

secondary_targets.definition: sign of next economic-trade canonical price change
secondary_targets.name: next_price_change_sign

secondary_targets.definition: economic trade count in following 60 seconds
secondary_targets.name: activity_60

secondary_targets.definition: participant-owner YES pressure times 60-second future logit change
secondary_targets.name: signed_60

secondary_targets.definition: participant-owner YES pressure times 300-second future logit change
secondary_targets.name: signed_300

splits.dev: 70th to 85th timestamp quantile, with 300s pre-HOLDOUT embargo and label-crossing purge
splits.holdout: 85th percentile onward; inspected once after immutable DEV freeze
splits.rule: split boundaries depend on timestamps only, never response outcomes
splits.train: timestamps below the 70th participant-row timestamp quantile, with 300s pre-boundary embargo and label-crossing purge
